flrender.option.quality.tooltip:
How much our mods' effects may cost (anomalies, portals, eyes, screen effects).
Low - the plain, flat ways, for a weak computer.
Medium - more per-pixel detail.
High - all the main things.
Ultra - everything at its best.
Below, each technique can be switched on or off by itself (Auto = as the quality says).
flrender.detect.chosen: FL Render: effects quality set to "%s" for your computer. Change it: Options > Video Settings > FL Render tab.
flrender.detect.lowered: FL Render: %s frames per second on average - effects quality lowered to "%s". Change it: Options > Video Settings > FL Render.
Torches, lanterns, redstone, lava, fire, glow sticks and coloured light blocks tint what they light in their colour; anomalies and portals cast light in theirs. The light spreads block by block round you, goes round corners, not through walls. The picture only: the world's light levels don't change. Colours and more blocks: config/flrender_colors.json. Reach: medium 48 blocks, high 64, ultra 96.
flrender.technique.flrender.held_light.t: A torch, lantern, glow stick, lava bucket... in hand (yours and others'), dropped or flying lights the area round it in its colour. Off with a shader pack - the pack does it itself.
flrender.technique.flrender.flashlight.t: The Survivor's Arsenal flashlight (yours and others', up to 4) gives real light: its cone lights blocks as they are drawn, like a torch - colours show even in full darkness; people, mobs, mannequins and chests in the beam are lit as if a torch were next to them. It does not pass through walls, closed doors or slabs. The flashlight circle stays on top. Off with a shader pack - there only the flashlight circle.
flrender.option.color_range.tooltip:
How far the colour of light sources (torches, lamps, glow sticks) is shown, in chunks.
As render distance - as far as the light itself (capped by quality: medium 12, high 24, ultra 32 chunks; 2-4 sections above and below you).
Memory depends on how many coloured sources are near, not on the range; lower - for a weak computer, the colour ends softly.
